ns2:course.label: Govt Regulation of Industry
ns2:course.description: Microeconomic and econometric analyses of market failure and government response in selected industries; topics include economic effect of regulation, bureaucratic behavior, optimal policy, and strategies for regulatory reform. Prerequisite: ECON 502; ECON 580; or consent of Instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ECON 502; ECON 580; or consent of Instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to PHD:Economics -UIUC.
